findings.message: No beat reaches 6/10 in the first 10% of the experience (best is 3). Players decide early whether to keep going.
findings.suggestion: Open with a short, legible high-interest moment (a promise of the core fantasy, a striking reveal, or a quick win), then dip to teach.

findings.message: 1.2-3.2: intensity stays within ±0.5 around 3.9 for 2.0 units (low and flat: boredom and quit risk).
findings.suggestion: Insert a contrast beat: a twist on the current mechanic, a new threat, a reveal, a reward, or a deliberate rest that sets up the next rise.

findings.message: 3.2-8.1: intensity stays within ±0.5 around 5.0 for 4.9 units (flat: interest stops moving).
findings.suggestion: Insert a contrast beat: a twist on the current mechanic, a new threat, a reveal, a reward, or a deliberate rest that sets up the next rise.

findings.message: 8.2-10.2: intensity stays within ±0.5 around 5.8 for 2.0 units (flat: interest stops moving).
findings.suggestion: Insert a contrast beat: a twist on the current mechanic, a new threat, a reveal, a reward, or a deliberate rest that sets up the next rise.

findings.message: 12.0-14.5: intensity stays within ±0.5 around 8.6 for 2.5 units (high and flat: numbness and fatigue risk).
findings.suggestion: Insert a contrast beat: a twist on the current mechanic, a new threat, a reveal, a reward, or a deliberate rest that sets up the next rise.

findings.message: 12.0-14.5: intensity stays at or above 8 for 2.5 units (17% of the run).
findings.suggestion: Break the plateau into two peaks with a short release between them, or vary the kind of intensity (spatial, cognitive, emotional).
